findings.highlight: she didn't look like she was in the mood
findings.evidenceJa: ご機嫌をうかがっているようで嫌
findings.governingReading: ご機嫌をうかがっているようで嫌 locates reluctance in his own dislike of seeming to curry favor while they are fighting.
findings.explanation: Shirou rejecting apparent appeasement becomes Saber not being in the mood.

findings.governingReading: Shirou says he has mostly dealt with making breakfast, answering Sakura's question about that task.
findings.explanation: Shirou's report that breakfast is mostly prepared becomes a report that cleanup has just finished, changing the work Sakura finds him doing.

findings.highlight: I just felt like making potato salad.
findings.evidenceJa: 単に少し日和っただけ
findings.governingReading: 負けたワケではない ... 少し日和っただけ is a comic hairsplitting admission of accommodation after declaring he will not appease Saber.
findings.explanation: He has only compromised a little becomes merely feeling like potato salad.

findings.highlight: please don't talk to my brother today.
findings.evidenceJa: 今は兄さんに関わらないでください
findings.governingReading: 今は兄さんに関わらない warns against involvement broadly during his unstable state; it is not restricted to conversation or an exact calendar day.
findings.explanation: Do not get involved with Shinji for now becomes do not talk to him today.

findings.highlight: pushing yourself because you haven't been feeling well.
findings.evidenceJa: 体調が悪いっていうのに無理しようとした
findings.governingReading: 体調が悪いっていうのに無理しようとした marks the illness as the reason not to exert himself, overridden by Sakura.
findings.explanation: Pushing despite poor health becomes pushing because of poor health.

findings.highlight: Surely, that accident happened because she wasn't paying attention...right?
findings.evidenceJa: 不注意……というわけじゃなさそう
findings.governingReading: 不注意 ... というわけじゃなさそう rejects the easy explanation and leads to his question about a collapse.
findings.explanation: The collision does not seem due to carelessness becomes it surely was carelessness, right.

findings.governingReading: Already, foreseen, and inconceivable are the intended spellings.
findings.explanation: Several intact rows contain straightforward misspellings.
